headline: Approved $2,300,320 Elm Street Garage office renovation contract amendment, $329,500 wastewater flow monitoring contract, and no-parking ordinance for Celina Avenue.
summary: Approved contracts for the Elm Street Garage office renovation, Vector Solutions software renewal, and collection system flow monitoring. Adopted resolutions on a Mine Falls Park antenna site lease and the Nimco site agreement, and adopted the Celina Avenue no-parking ordinance. Referred several new resolutions and ordinances to committees and scheduled an August 18, 2026 public hearing on the video display signs overlay district.
decisions: Approved an amendment to the contract with Whiting-Turner Contracting Company for build out and renovation of the parking department office in the Elm Street Garage, not to exceed $2,300,320. Motion carried.

Approved the renewal of the annual software subscription with Target Solutions Learning, LLC d/b/a Vector Solutions for Nashua Fire Rescue's online training platform, not to exceed $79,546.29. Motion carried.
Approved a three-year contract with ADS Environmental Services for flow monitoring of the collection system, not to exceed $329,500. Motion carried.
Accepted and placed on file the May 11, 2026 Budget Review Committee report.
Adopted Resolution R-26-038, authorizing the conveyance of discontinued portions of Major Drive and Spalding Street, on final passage. Motion carried.

Adopted Resolution R-26-043, authorizing a fourth amendment to the site lease agreement with New Cingular Wireless PCS, LLC for the cellular antenna site at Mine Falls Park, on final passage. Motion carried.

Adopted Resolution R-26-047, authorizing an amended and restated master development agreement and fourth amendment to the purchase and sale agreement with Lansing Melbourne Group, LLC regarding the Nimco site, on final passage. Motion carried.
Adopted Ordinance O-26-015, no parking on sections of Celina Avenue, on final passage. Motion carried.
Referred Resolution R-26-049, establishing a homeless services gap analysis committee, to the Personnel/Administrative Affairs Committee after first reading.
Referred Resolution R-26-050, relating to a fiscal year 2026 transfer of $35,000 for funding to the Nashua Association for the Elderly, to the Budget Review Committee after first reading.
Referred Resolution R-26-051, relating to auctioning tax deeded property, to the Committee on Infrastructure after first reading.
Referred Ordinance O-26-020, allowing overnight on-street parking in Ward 5 from May 1 to October 31, except on certain main roads, to the Committee on Infrastructure after first reading.
Referred Ordinance O-26-021, increasing the individual public comment time during the first public comment period, to the Personnel/Administrative Affairs Committee after first reading.

Referred Ordinance O-26-022, establishing the video display signs overlay district, to the Planning and Economic Development Committee and Planning Board after first reading, and scheduled a public hearing for Tuesday, August 18, 2026, at 7:00 p.m.
